temporal_resolution: mixed dated static references; not weekly observations

field_notes.population_and_households: Actual 2020 census. Household size uses household population, not total population.
field_notes.area: Existing CPDD 2020 barangay area basis. Non-barangay Reservoir/QMC rows and disputed district aggregate density are excluded.
field_notes.flood: MGB 2021 susceptibility from CDRA 2022. 119 listed records; 23 nulls. Not observed weekly flooding.
field_notes.waste: Estimated from projected 2021 population times 0.44 kg/person/day; not an independent sanitation measurement.
field_notes.historical_use: Reference/publication dates must be respected. Historical application requires explicit assumptions; these are not contemporaneous observations for every prior year.
